The pinned Vercel API permits custom image names; Localbox preserves the reference as untrusted provenance but does not provide registry authentication.

entries.selector: stable default, Python, OpenCode, and musl aliases
entries.rationale: Each stable alias resolves only to the exact matching 0.12.9 container image and cannot consume a preview tag.

entries.selector: preview default, Python, OpenCode, and musl aliases
entries.rationale: Each preview alias resolves only to the exact matching next container image and cannot consume a stable tag.

entries.selector: Wrangler deployment and hosted image publication metadata
entries.rationale: Worker deployment identifiers and Cloudflare registry publication metadata do not select or alter a pre-existing local boot artifact.
Localbox does not invoke Wrangler or a hosted build pipeline and requires one concrete OCI artifact before client creation.

An E2B template resolves only when the same ID or name is configured to a validated local OCI artifact; hosted lookup is never attempted.
Hosted ownership, billing, and publication metadata have no local artifact-selection effect.
Hosted template lookup and dynamic Template builds cannot be converted into a local OCI reference without an explicit mapping.
The pinned Daytona create overload permits an image string; Localbox accepts the concrete reference but not private authentication or hosted snapshot construction.
A Daytona snapshot resolves only when an actual local snapshot artifact is configured and the selected backend identity and capabilities satisfy restore.

entries.selector: hosted region and snapshot publication metadata
entries.rationale: Hosted placement and publication metadata do not change the identity of an already present local snapshot artifact.

entries.selector: default or language-hosted snapshot and dynamic Image build
entries.rationale: Localbox never guesses a hosted default snapshot and does not run Daytona's dynamic image-to-snapshot build pipeline.
Registry credentials are not accepted by the BootArtifact or SandboxClient boundary and cannot be silently omitted.
